name: Omega Vanitas
storyline:
Humanity's civilization has collapsed, leaving behind a vast and dangerous post-apocalyptic wasteland. The surviving world is filled with abandoned locations, hostile gangs, mutated creatures and the remains of a society that no longer exists. The exact cause of mankind's extermination remains uncertain, with the game itself presenting nuclear war and a deadly virus as possible explanations.

The player enters this harsh world with survival as the immediate priority. Exploration and scavenging are essential for finding equipment and resources, while quests lead the player through different locations, enemies and dungeons. Character development allows skills, attributes and equipment to be improved over time, while pets and hired companions can assist in surviving the wasteland.

Survival is not limited to fighting the environment. Other players inhabit the same online world, allowing characters to trade, challenge one another in real-time PvP and cooperate through factions. Players can join an existing faction or establish their own and construct faction structures to expand its influence.

The game leaves the wider mystery of the world's destruction deliberately open: the player is invited to survive, explore and uncover what happened to humanity while building a place for themselves in the remains of civilization.
summary:
Omega Vanitas is a free-to-play post-apocalyptic open-world MMORPG featuring a retro 2D isometric presentation inspired by classic top-down role-playing games. Players explore a dangerous wasteland, scavenge for resources and equipment, complete quests, fight enemy gangs and mutated creatures, and develop their characters through experience, levels, skills, and attributes.

The game combines exploration and character progression with player interaction, item crafting and trading, pets and companions, real-time PvP combat, and faction-based gameplay. Players can join or create factions, construct faction structures, and work with other survivors while searching the wasteland for equipment and attempting to uncover what caused humanity's downfall.
